assertions: Treats optimize-with-human as a Goal Advisor preset, not a separate loop runtime

Requires or points to a ticket-backed Goal Packet with ticket.md, program.md, hypothesis-tree.json, and progress.md for this multi-turn optimization loop
Binds phase=planning or phase=execution before requesting feedback
Uses proposal cards, offer briefs, storyboard premises, hook batches, or compact plans as valid planning-phase artifacts

Requires non-trivial planning feedback to include audience or buyer, taste insight, artifact shape, core angle, execution beats, why it could win, cringe risks, references or taste pack, feedback question, and next step if approved

Requires approved_plan_ref before execution-phase feedback unless the artifact is explicitly a tiny planning test

Asks one short review question Kenji can answer quickly

Seed and select the first hypothesis, show the feedback turn writeback, and state what a one-off review would omit.
evals.expected_output: Extracts the source facts; Seeds a concrete hypothesis with expected reward fields; Uses one ordinal selection; Updates the tree before progress after feedback; Omits the tree for one-off review
assertions: Extracts source refs, technique, mechanism, and variables into a concrete intervention hypothesis
Records expected observation, falsifier, expected reward, and reward basis before feedback
